title: 第735章 孙悟空找武曲星君试验不正经神通第734章 不出手则已一出手就是大的
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：西游：开局获得太白金星传承第一卷：默认第735章孙悟空找武曲星君试验不正经神通（..la）杨戬、哪吒和孙悟空看着那五尊准圣后期的惨状，都咋舌不已。
“还得是黄风兄弟啊，出手就来了波狠的。”
“谁说不是呢，我还以为黄风兄弟已经舍弃了不正经神通，没想到啊，原来是等着在大场合用啊。”
哪吒和杨戬代入了一下那五尊准圣后期。
堂堂准圣后期，纵横寰宇万界无数元会。
如今却挺着肚子在战场上生孩子，而且还是一胎十个。
简直凄凄惨惨戚戚，惨不忍睹。
还不如直接杀了他们呢。
而孙悟空则是双眼放光，抓耳挠腮，兴奋不已。
“妙啊！
妙啊！”
同时他也暗怪自己，这么多年一直苦修，都懈怠了。
忘记对不正经神通的继续开发。
如今看到叶云在战场上“大放异彩”
孙悟空自然是羡慕不已的。
已然决定，接下来要继续开发新的不正经神通了，不能总是老三样。
得推陈出新，与时俱进。
想到这里，孙悟空看向杨戬和哪吒，一脸期待，满脸真诚。
“黄风兄弟的不正经神通给了我不少的灵感，我有了新的想法！”
“怎么样，你俩要不要试试？”
听到这话，杨戬和哪吒沉默了片刻。
然后齐齐朝着孙悟空背后行礼，神色恭敬。
“菩提祖师，您来了。”
“什么，师父他老人家来了？”
孙悟空连忙回头，四处张望。
却连根毛都没看到。
只有空荡荡的虚空，和远处打扫战场的天兵天将。
而他再转过头时，却见杨戬和哪吒已经跑没影了。
只留下两道流光，一左一右，消失在天际。
看他俩的样子，简直把速度提升到了极限，显然不敢逗留一点！
“还说是兄弟呢，这点小忙都不愿意帮……”
孙悟空摇了摇头。
“算了，还是去找武曲星君吧。”
“他肯定很乐意帮我。”
与此同时，正在清点战利品的武曲星君。
忽然打了个寒颤。
不寒而栗，汗毛倒竖，道心预警。
仿佛有什么大恐怖即将降临。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Journey to the West: Obtaining the Taibaijin Star Inheritance at the Beginning Volume 1: Default Chapter 735 Sun Wukong asked Wuqu Xingjun to test his unorthodox magical powers (..la) Yang Jian, Nezha and Sun Wukong were all speechless when they saw the miserable state of the five quasi-sage in the late stage.
"It has to be Brother Huang Feng, he will be ruthless when he strikes."
"Who says otherwise? I thought Brother Huang Feng had given up on his unorthodox magical powers. Unexpectedly, it turned out that he was just waiting to use them on big occasions."
Nezha and Yang Jian took the place of the five late-stage quasi-sages.
In the later stage of the dignified quasi-sage, there are countless Yuanhui across the world.
Now she is giving birth to ten babies on the battlefield with a full belly.
It's simply miserable and miserable, too miserable to look at.
Might as well just kill them.
Sun Wukong, on the other hand, had his eyes shining, scratching his head, and was very excited.
"Wonderful!
Wonderful! "
At the same time, he also secretly blamed himself for slacking off after practicing hard for so many years.
Forget about the continued development of perverse spiritual powers.
Now I see Ye Yun "shines brightly" on the battlefield
Sun Wukong is naturally envious.
It has been decided that the next step is to continue to develop new and unorthodox supernatural powers. It cannot always be the third best.
We have to innovate and keep pace with the times.
Thinking of this, Sun Wukong looked at Yang Jian and Nezha with expectations and sincerity on his face.
"Brother Huang Feng's unorthodox supernatural powers gave me a lot of inspiration, and I have new ideas!"
"How about it, do you two want to try it?"
Hearing this, Yang Jian and Nezha were silent for a moment.
Then they all saluted behind Sun Wukong with respectful expressions.
"Master Bodhi, you are here."
"What, Master, the old man is here?"
Sun Wukong quickly turned back and looked around.
But not even a hair was seen.
There is only the empty void and the heavenly soldiers and generals cleaning the battlefield in the distance.
When he turned his head again, he saw that Yang Jian and Nezha had disappeared.
Only two streams of light were left, one on the left and one on the right, disappearing into the sky.
Judging from the looks of the two of them, they had simply increased their speed to the limit, and obviously they didn't dare to stay any longer!
"They say they are brothers, but they are not even willing to help with this little favor..."
Sun Wukong shook his head.
"Forget it, let's go find Mr. Wu Quxing."
"He'd be happy to help me."
At the same time, Wuqu Xingjun was counting the loot.
Suddenly I shuddered.
I shuddered, the hairs on my hair stood on end, and my Taoist heart warned me.
It seemed as if some great terror was about to come.
title_en: Chapter 735 Sun Wukong goes to Wu Qu Xingjun to test his unorthodox supernatural powers. Chapter 734 If you don’t take action, you will be the big one once you do it.
